title: Minimax Design When the Exposure Mapping Is Known Only up to a Finite Menu
banked_reason: Sound latent-menu minimax framework, but field novelty is not delivered: witnesses are engineered two-signature replications, the collision sandwich is rate-loose at no interference, and no natural scalable compression regime is proved.
gap_reasons: The persistent separation is an n=2 replication: every growing witness is a labeled type blow-up observed through the same two selector cells.
The collision sandwich is badly calibrated on no interference: inf C_n = Theta(n^-1), L_n = Theta(n^-1/2), and inf U_n = 2, so both sides miss the frontier by a factor of order sqrt(n).

The R_n compression theorem exactly computes a collision surrogate and has no natural positive instance in the note; its polynomial regime is demonstrated only by engineered small-signature witnesses.
Comparator positioning establishes a distinct latent-menu scope, but not a head-on matched frontier over a natural family comparable to the accepted SNIPE result.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery produced a sound exact finite decision formulation, sign reduction, primal-dual minimax saddle, oracle-adaptation counterexamples, collision bounds, and signature-compression results. Formalization reached F2/F2.5 scaffolding but was stopped before proof filling; all partial Lean files were removed. The field-tier promise collapsed because the persistent and graph-local witnesses reduce to engineered two-signature replications, the collision sandwich fails to recover even the no-interference rate, and no natural scalable compression regime or matched natural-family frontier was obtained. A future upgrade should begin with a genuinely many-coordinate lower bound or a sparse/bounded-degree latent-menu family, not resume the discarded scaffold unchanged.
tldr: For fixed \(\bar p\in(0,1)\), a one-shot exact-budget experiment at \(n\in\mathcal N_{\bar p}\) must estimate the all-treated-versus-all-control causal effect of a fixed bounded potential-outcome table obeying one unknown member of a finite exposure-mapping menu. Sign schedules give an exact finite decision reduction, a primal--dual second-order cone saddle computes \(V_n^\star(\mathcal E,\bar p)=L_n(\mathcal E,\bar p)\), and an optimal solution recovers an attaining design and multilinear rule. The unconditional joint-signature certificate \(R_n\le|\Omega_n|\) yields an exact collision linear program and a universal congestion-\(R_n\) cover; if \(R_n=O(\log n)\), the menu size is fixed, and the incidence encoding is polynomial, the certificate is polynomial-size with polynomial-time coefficient computation. Locality and polynomial orbit tables alone are insufficient: no interference has collision scale \(n^{-1}\), exact frontier scale \(n^{-1/2}\), fiber modulus two, and necessary cover congestion \(\Omega(n^2)\). An explicit dense radius-one split-graph sequence has equal mapping-wise labeled conflict-graph multisets but exact latent-menu risks \(1\) and \(5/4\), a persistent separation of \(1/4\). Bounded-degree or sparse-natural local separation and broad primitive conditions guaranteeing the compression regime remain open. Relative to accepted-bank \texttt{exp\_snipe\_degree\_frontier\_v1/thm:bounded-outcome-degree-frontier}, which treats one known \(\beta\)-order neighborhood-interference model under unit Bernoulli assignment and clipped SNIPE, the finite-saddle theorem handles a latent finite menu of arbitrary bounded exposure-measurable tables, optimizes over all exact-treated-count assignment laws, and permits arbitrary measurable decision rules.
gap: Faridani and Niehaus study the same global average treatment effect and jointly derive minimax rates over designs and linear estimators under spillovers decaying in a known generalized distance. Other work characterizes one known ANI model, tests nested exposure specifications, or optimizes a correctly specified linear spillover model. Schröder, Oprescu, Feuerriegel, and Kallus derive sharp sensitivity and partial-identification bounds under exposure-mapping misspecification for both experimental and observational data, taking the assignment regime as fixed or externally given; they neither choose an exact-treated-count design nor solve an unrestricted design--estimator minimax saddle over a latent finite exposure menu. No comparator gives a finite exact saddle over arbitrary estimators and unrestricted bounded response tables for that latent union.
fill: The finite primal and least-favourable-prior dual compute the exact minimax risk at each \(n\in\mathcal N_{\bar p}\) and recover an attaining design and lossless multilinear representative. The collision-geometry sandwich exposes primitive lower and upper certificates, and at \(\bar p=1/2\) the persistent even-population witness proves that the required information is strictly richer than a multiset of mapping-wise conflict graphs.
